fields.summary_ko.0: TSMC Q3 2026 revenue increased 41.2% year-over-year, net income increased 68.7%, and ADR earnings per share recorded $4.60
fields.summary_ko.1: TSMC's operating margin expanded 810bp to 58.7% year-over-year, high-performance computing (HPC) accounted for 68% of Q3 revenue, up 22% from previous quarter
fields.summary_ko.2: TSMC raised 2026 revenue growth rate to 44%, 2-nanometer technology accounted for 8% of Q3 wafer revenue, and annual production capacity in 2027 is expected to more than double
